title: លំហាត់ និងដំណោះស្រាយ លីមីត
html:
លំហាត់

ដោយប្រើនិយមន័យចូរបង្ហាញថា៖

  1. \(\lim_{x \to -2}\frac{x^2-1}{x+1}=-3\)

  2. \(\lim_{x \to a}(mx+b) = ma+b\)

  3. \(\lim_{x \to 0}\sqrt[3]{x} = 0\)

  4. \(\lim_{x \to 2} \sqrt{x} =\sqrt{2}\)

  5. \(\lim_{x \to 2^-}\sqrt{(x-2)(x-3)}= 0\)

  6. \(\lim_{x \to 2}\frac{x^2-1}{x}=\frac{3}{2}\)

ដោយប្រើនិយមន័យចូរបង្ហាញថា៖

  1. \(\lim_{x \to -2}\frac{x^2-1}{x+1}=-3\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow \left|\frac{x^2-1}{x+1}-(-3)\right| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow \left|\frac{(x+2)(x+1)}{x+1}\right| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |x+2| < \varepsilon = \alpha \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \varepsilon > 0\) នោះ \(\forall |x+2| < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  2. \(\lim_{x \to a}(mx+b) = ma+b\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow |(mx+b)-(ma+b)| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |m(x-a)| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |m||x-a| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |x-a| < \frac{\varepsilon}{|m|} \quad{} (m\neq 0) \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \frac{\varepsilon}{|m|} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall |x-a| < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  3. \(\lim_{x \to 0}\sqrt[3]{x} = 0\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow |\sqrt[3]{x}-0| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |\sqrt[3]{x}| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |x| < \varepsilon^3 \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \varepsilon^3 > 0\) នោះ \(\forall |x| < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  4. \(\lim_{x \to 2} \sqrt{x} =\sqrt{2}\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow |\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{2}| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow \frac{|x-2|}{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{2}} < \varepsilon \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(1 < x < 3\) នោះ \(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{2} > 1+\sqrt{2} > 2\)៖
    \(\frac{|x-2|}{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{2}} < \frac{|x-2|}{2} < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x-2| < 2\varepsilon\)
    យក \(\alpha = \min(1, 2\varepsilon) > 0\) នោះ \(\forall |x-2| < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

ដំណោះស្រាយ (ត)

  1. \(\lim_{x \to 2^-}\sqrt{(x-2)(x-3)}= 0\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-0| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow |\sqrt{(x-2)(x-3)}| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow |x-2||x-3| < \varepsilon^2 \quad{} (*) \end{aligned}\)
    ដោយ \(x \to 2^-\) យក \(1 < x < 2\)៖
    \(\begin{aligned} 1 < x < 2 &\Leftrightarrow -2 < x-3 < -1\\ &\Leftrightarrow 1 < |x-3| < 2 \quad{} (**) \end{aligned}\)
    តាម \((*)\) និង \((**)\) យើងបាន៖
    \(|x-2||x-3| < 2|x-2| < \varepsilon^2 \Leftrightarrow |x-2| < \frac{\varepsilon^2}{2}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \frac{\varepsilon^2}{2} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall |x-2| < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  2. \(\lim_{x \to 2}\frac{x^2-1}{x}=\frac{3}{2}\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \left|\frac{x^2-1}{x}-\frac{3}{2}\right| &= \left|\frac{2x^2-3x-2}{2x}\right|\\ &= \frac{|x-2||2x+1|}{|2x|} < \varepsilon \quad{} (*) \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(1 < x < 3\)៖
    \(\bullet\) \(2 < 2x < 6 \Rightarrow |2x| > 2 \Rightarrow \frac{1}{|2x|} < \frac{1}{2}\)
    \(\bullet\) \(3 < 2x+1 < 7 \Rightarrow |2x+1| < 7\)
    តាម \((*)\) នាំឱ្យ៖
    \(\frac{|x-2||2x+1|}{|2x|} < \frac{7|x-2|}{2} < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x-2| < \frac{2\varepsilon}{7}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \min\left(1, \frac{2\varepsilon}{7}\right) > 0\) នោះនាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

លំហាត់

ដោយប្រើនិយមន័យចូរបង្ហាញថា៖

  1. \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^-}\frac{3x-1}{x-2} =-\infty\)

  2. \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^+}\frac{4x+1}{x-2} = +\infty\)

  3. \(\lim_{x \to - \infty}\frac{x^2-2}{x^2+2} = 1\)

  4. \(\lim_{x \to + \infty}\frac{3x+1}{x} = 3\)

  5. \(\lim_{x \to - \infty}(x^2-x-1) =+\infty\)

  6. \(\lim_{x \to + \infty}\frac{x^2+3}{2-x} =-\infty\)

ដោយប្រើនិយមន័យចូរបង្ហាញថា៖

  1. \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^-}\frac{3x-1}{x-2} =-\infty\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall M > 0, f(x) < -M\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \frac{3x-1}{x-2} < -M &\Leftrightarrow 3+\frac{5}{x-2} < -M\\ &\Leftrightarrow \frac{5}{x-2} < -(M+3)\\ &\Leftrightarrow \frac{5}{2-x} > M+3 \quad{} (x < 2)\\ &\Leftrightarrow 2-x < \frac{5}{M+3} \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \frac{5}{M+3} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall 0 < 2-x < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(f(x) < -M\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  2. \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^+}\frac{4x+1}{x-2} = +\infty\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall M > 0, f(x) > M\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \frac{4x+1}{x-2} > M &\Leftrightarrow 4+\frac{9}{x-2} > M\\ &\Leftarrow \frac{9}{x-2} > M \quad{} (x > 2)\\ &\Leftrightarrow x-2 < \frac{9}{M} \end{aligned}\)
    យក \(\alpha = \frac{9}{M} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall 0 < x-2 < \alpha\) នាំឱ្យ \(f(x) > M\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  3. \(\lim_{x \to - \infty}\frac{x^2-2}{x^2+2} = 1\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-1| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow \left|\frac{x^2-2}{x^2+2}-1\right| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow \frac{4}{x^2+2} < \frac{4}{x^2} < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow x^2 > \frac{4}{\varepsilon} \Leftrightarrow |x| > \frac{2}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}} \end{aligned}\)
    ដោយ \(x \to -\infty \Rightarrow |x| = -x > \frac{2}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}} \Leftrightarrow x < -\frac{2}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}}\)
    យក \(N = \frac{2}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall x < -N\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-1| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  4. \(\lim_{x \to + \infty}\frac{3x+1}{x} = 3\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, |f(x)-L| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\begin{aligned} |f(x)-3| < \varepsilon &\Leftrightarrow \left|\frac{3x+1}{x}-3\right| < \varepsilon\\ &\Leftrightarrow \frac{1}{|x|} < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x| > \frac{1}{\varepsilon} \end{aligned}\)
    ដោយ \(x \to +\infty \Rightarrow |x| = x > \frac{1}{\varepsilon}\)
    យក \(N = \frac{1}{\varepsilon} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall x > N\) នាំឱ្យ \(|f(x)-3| < \varepsilon\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  5. \(\lim_{x \to - \infty}(x^2-x-1) =+\infty\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall M > 0, f(x) > M\)
    \(\begin{aligned} x^2-x-1 > M &\Leftrightarrow \left(x-\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{5}{4} > M\\ &\Leftrightarrow \left(x-\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 > M+\frac{5}{4}\\ &\Leftrightarrow \left|x-\frac{1}{2}\right| > \sqrt{M+\frac{5}{4}} \end{aligned}\)
    ដោយ \(x \to -\infty \Rightarrow \left|x-\frac{1}{2}\right| = \frac{1}{2}-x > \sqrt{M+\frac{5}{4}}\)
    \(\Rightarrow x < \frac{1}{2}-\sqrt{M+\frac{5}{4}} < -\sqrt{M}\)
    យក \(N = \sqrt{M+\frac{5}{4}} > 0\) នោះ \(\forall x < -N\) នាំឱ្យ \(f(x) > M\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  6. \(\lim_{x \to + \infty}\frac{x^2+3}{2-x} =-\infty\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\forall M > 0, f(x) < -M\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \frac{x^2+3}{2-x} < -M &\Leftrightarrow -(x+2) + \frac{7}{2-x} < -M \end{aligned}\)
    ចំពោះ \(x > 3\) នោះ \(\frac{7}{2-x} < 0\) នាំឱ្យ៖
    \(-(x+2) < -M \Leftrightarrow x > M-2\)
    យក \(N = M+2 > 0\) នោះ \(\forall x > N\) នាំឱ្យ \(f(x) < -M\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

លំហាត់

គណនាតម្លៃ \(\alpha > 0\) ទៅតាមតម្លៃ \(\varepsilon\) នីមួយៗដែលគេឱ្យដូចខាងក្រោម៖

  1. \(\lim_{x \to 2}(x^2+x-6) = 0 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 10^{-7})\)

  2. \(\lim_{x \to -3}(x^2+x-6) = 0 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 10^{-9})\)

  3. \(\lim_{x \to -1}(3-4x) = 7 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2})\)

  4. \(\lim_{x \to 3}x^2 = 9 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 5\times 10^{-3})\)

  5. \(\lim_{x \to -2}\frac{x^2-4}{x+2} = -4 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 10^{-2})\)

  6. \(\lim_{x \to -2}(2+5x) = -8 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2})\)

គណនាតម្លៃ \(\alpha > 0\) ទៅតាមតម្លៃ \(\varepsilon\) នីមួយៗដែលគេឱ្យ៖

  1. \(\lim_{x \to 2}(x^2+x-6) = 0 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 10^{-7})\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(|(x^2+x-6)-0| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\Leftrightarrow |x+3||x-2| < \varepsilon \quad{} (*)\)
    ដោយ \(x \to 2\) យក \(1 < x < 3 \Rightarrow |x+3| < 6 \quad{} (**)\)
    តាម \((*)\) និង \((**)\) យើងបាន៖
    \(6|x-2| < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x-2| < \frac{\varepsilon}{6} = \alpha\)
    តែ \(\varepsilon = 10^{-7} \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{10^{-7}}{6}\)
    ដូចនេះ បើ \(\varepsilon = 10^{-7}\) នោះ \(\alpha = \frac{10^{-7}}{6}\)

  2. \(\lim_{x \to -3}(x^2+x-6) = 0 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 10^{-9})\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(|(x^2+x-6)-0| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\Leftrightarrow |x+3||x-2| < \varepsilon \quad{} (*)\)
    ដោយ \(x \to -3\) យក \(-4 < x < -2 \Rightarrow |x-2| < 6 \quad{} (**)\)
    តាម \((*)\) និង \((**)\) យើងបាន៖
    \(6|x+3| < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x+3| < \frac{\varepsilon}{6} = \alpha\)
    តែ \(\varepsilon = 10^{-9} \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{10^{-9}}{6}\)
    ដូចនេះ បើ \(\varepsilon = 10^{-9}\) នោះ \(\alpha = \frac{10^{-9}}{6}\)

  3. \(\lim_{x \to -1}(3-4x) = 7 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2})\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(|(3-4x)-7| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\Leftrightarrow |-4(x+1)| < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x+1| < \frac{\varepsilon}{4} = \alpha\)
    តែ \(\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2} \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{2\times 10^{-2}}{4} = \frac{10^{-2}}{2}\)
    ដូចនេះ បើ \(\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2}\) នោះ \(\alpha = \frac{10^{-2}}{2}\)

  4. \(\lim_{x \to 3}x^2 = 9 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 5\times 10^{-3})\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(|x^2-9| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\Leftrightarrow |x+3||x-3| < \varepsilon \quad{} (*)\)
    ដោយ \(x \to 3\) យក \(2 < x < 4 \Rightarrow |x+3| < 7 \quad{} (**)\)
    តាម \((*)\) និង \((**)\) យើងបាន៖
    \(7|x-3| < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x-3| < \frac{\varepsilon}{7} = \alpha\)
    តែ \(\varepsilon = 5\times 10^{-3} \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{5\times 10^{-3}}{7}\)
    ដូចនេះ បើ \(\varepsilon = 5\times 10^{-3}\) នោះ \(\alpha = \frac{5\times 10^{-3}}{7}\)

  5. \(\lim_{x \to -2}\frac{x^2-4}{x+2} = -4 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 10^{-2})\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(\left|\frac{x^2-4}{x+2}-(-4)\right| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\Leftrightarrow \left|\frac{(x+2)^2}{x+2}\right| = |x+2| < \varepsilon = \alpha\)
    តែ \(\varepsilon = 10^{-2} \Rightarrow \alpha = 10^{-2}\)
    ដូចនេះ បើ \(\varepsilon = 10^{-2}\) នោះ \(\alpha = 10^{-2}\)

  6. \(\lim_{x \to -2}(2+5x) = -8 \quad{} (\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2})\)
    តាមនិយមន័យ៖ \(|(2+5x)-(-8)| < \varepsilon\)
    \(\Leftrightarrow |5(x+2)| < \varepsilon \Leftrightarrow |x+2| < \frac{\varepsilon}{5} = \alpha\)
    តែ \(\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2} \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{2\times 10^{-2}}{5}\)
    ដូចនេះ បើ \(\varepsilon = 2\times 10^{-2}\) នោះ \(\alpha = \frac{2\times 10^{-2}}{5}\)

លំហាត់

ចូររកតម្លៃធំបំផុតនៃ \(\alpha > 0\) ដែលផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់លក្ខខណ្ឌខាងក្រោម៖

  1. \(0<|x+2|<\alpha\) ដែល \(0<|3x+6|<0.000009\)

  2. \(0<|x+3|<\alpha\) ដែល \(0<\left|\frac{4x^2+24x+36}{x+3}\right|<0.000000044\)

ចូររកតម្លៃធំបំផុតនៃ \(\alpha > 0\) ដែលផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់លក្ខខណ្ឌខាងក្រោម៖

  1. \(0<|x+2|<\alpha\) ដែល \(0<|3x+6|<0.000009\)
    \(\begin{aligned} 0<|3x+6|<0.000009 &\Leftrightarrow 0<|3(x+2)|<0.000009\\ &\Leftrightarrow 0<|x+2|<\frac{0.000009}{3}\\ &\Leftrightarrow 0<|x+2|<0.000003 \end{aligned}\)
    ដូចនេះ តម្លៃធំបំផុតនៃ

  2. \(0<|x+3|<\alpha\) ដែល \(0<\left|\frac{4x^2+24x+36}{x+3}\right|<0.000000044\)
    \(\begin{aligned} 0<\left|\frac{4x^2+24x+36}{x+3}\right| &= \left|\frac{4(x+3)^2}{x+3}\right|\\ &= |4(x+3)| < 0.000000044\\ &\Leftrightarrow |x+3| < \frac{0.000000044}{4}\\ &\Leftrightarrow |x+3| < 0.000000011 \end{aligned}\)
    ដូចនេះ តម្លៃធំបំផុតនៃ

លំហាត់

គណនាលីមីតខាងក្រោម៖

  1. \(\lim_{x \to 0}2020\)

  2. \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{2020}{2021}\)

  3. \(\lim_{x \to -2}(3x+4)\)

  4. \(\lim_{x \to 2}(x^2-x)\)

  5. \(\lim_{x \to 2}(5x^4-3x^3-x+2)\)

  6. \(\lim_{x \to 1}(x^2+x)(3x-4)\)

  7. \(\lim_{x \to 2}\frac{2x^2-1}{x-4}\)

  8. \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sin x}{x+1}\)

  9. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}}(\sin x +\cos x )\)

  10. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{\tan x +2}{\sin x+1}\)

  11. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{6}}\frac{\tan (2x) +\cot 3x}{\sin x}\)

  12. \(\lim_{x \to 1}(\ln x +\ln 4x)\)

  13. \(\lim_{x \to 3}e^{x+1}\cdot x\)

  14. \(\lim_{x \to 3}\frac{xe^{\frac{x}{3}}}{x+1}\)

គណនាលីមីតខាងក្រោម៖

  1. \(\lim_{x \to 0}2020\)
    តាមរូបមន្ត \(\lim_{x \to a} k = k\)
    ដូចនេះ

  2. \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{2020}{2021}\)
    តាមរូបមន្ត \(\lim_{x \to a} k = k\)
    ដូចនេះ

  3. \(\lim_{x \to -2}(3x+4)\)
    យើងបាន៖
    \(\lim_{x \to -2}(3x+4) = 3(-2)+4 = -2\)
    ដូចនេះ

  4. \(\lim_{x \to 2}(x^2-x)\)
    យើងបាន៖
    \(\lim_{x \to 2}(x^2-x) = 2^2-2 = 2\)
    ដូចនេះ

  5. \(\lim_{x \to 2}(5x^4-3x^3-x+2)\)
    យើងបាន៖
    \(\begin{aligned}[t] \lim_{x \to 2}(5x^4-3x^3-x+2) &= 5(2)^4 - 3(2)^3 - 2 + 2\\ &= 80 - 24 = 56 \end{aligned}\)
    ដូចនេះ

  6. \(\lim_{x \to 1}(x^2+x)(3x-4)\)
    យើងបាន៖
    \(\begin{aligned}[t] \lim_{x \to 1}(x^2+x)(3x-4) &= (1^2+1)(3(1)-4)\\ &= 2(-1) = -2 \end{aligned}\)
    ដូចនេះ

  7. \(\lim_{x \to 2}\frac{2x^2-1}{x-4}\)
    យើងបាន៖
    \(\lim_{x \to 2}\frac{2x^2-1}{x-4} = \frac{2(2)^2-1}{2-4} = -\frac{7}{2}\)
    ដូចនេះ

  8. \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sin x}{x+1}\)
    យើងបាន៖ \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sin x}{x+1} = \frac{\sin 0}{0+1} = 0\)
    ដូចនេះ

  9. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}}(\sin x +\cos x)\)
    យើងបាន៖ \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}}(\sin x +\cos x) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2}\)
    ដូចនេះ

  10. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{\tan x +2}{\sin x+1}\)
    យើងបាន៖ \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{\tan x +2}{\sin x+1} = \frac{\sqrt{3}+2}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+1} = 2\)
    ដូចនេះ

  11. \(\lim_{x \to \frac{\pi}{6}}\frac{\tan 2x +\cot 3x}{\sin x}\)

    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to + \infty } \frac{\ln x}{x(x - 1)} \\ &= \lim_{x \to + \infty }\left[ \frac{\ln x}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{x - 1} \right]\\ &=\lim_{x \to + \infty }\frac{\ln x}{x}\times \lim_{x \to + \infty }\frac{1}{x-1}\\ &= 0 \times 0 = 0 \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{ x \to -\infty } \ln (e^x+1)\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \ln (e^{-\infty}+1)\\ &=\ln (0+1)\\ &= \ln 1 = 0 \end{aligned}\)

  3. \(\lim_{ x \to 0^+ } \ln \left(\frac{x}{x+1}\right)\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0^+ } \ln \left[ \frac{x}{x\left( 1 + \frac{1}{x} \right)} \right] \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0^+ } \ln \frac{1}{1 + \frac{1}{x}} \\ &= \ln 0^+ = -\infty \end{aligned}\)

  4. \(\lim_{ x \to 0^+ } \frac{\ln^2 x+2\ln x+3}{\ln x +2}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{\infty}{\infty}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0^+ } \frac{\ln x\left( \ln x + 2 +\frac{3}{\ln x} \right)}{\ln x\left( 1 + \frac{2}{\ln x} \right)} \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0^+ } \frac{\ln x + 2 + \frac{3}{\ln x}}{1 + \frac{2}{\ln x}} \\ &= \frac{-\infty + 2 + 0}{1 + 0} = -\infty \end{aligned}\)

ដំណោះស្រាយ (ត)

  1. \(\lim_{ x \to + \infty} \ln \left(\frac{x^2+x-2}{x^2+1}\right)\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to + \infty } \ln \left[ \frac{x^2\left( 1 + \frac{1}{x} - \frac{2}{x^2} \right)}{x^2\left( 1 + \frac{1}{x^2} \right)} \right] \\ &= \lim_{x \to + \infty } \ln \frac{1 + \frac{1}{x} - \frac{2}{x^2}}{1 + \frac{1}{x^2}} \\ &= \ln \frac{1 + 0 - 0}{1 + 0} = \ln 1 = 0 \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{ x \to +\infty } \frac{3x\ln x}{x+2}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{\infty}{\infty}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to + \infty } \frac{3x\ln x}{x\left( 1 + \frac{2}{x} \right)} \\ &= \lim_{x \to + \infty } \frac{3\ln x}{1 + \frac{2}{x}} \\ &= \frac{3(+\infty)}{1 + 0} = +\infty \end{aligned}\)

  3. \(\lim_{ x \to +\infty } \frac{\ln x^{2020}-2020}{x^{2020}}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{\infty}{\infty}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to + \infty } \frac{2020(\ln x - 1)}{x^{2020}} \\ &= 2020\lim_{x \to + \infty } \left( \frac{\ln x}{x^{2020}} - \frac{1}{x^{2020}} \right) \\ &= 2020(0 - 0) = 0 \end{aligned}\)

  4. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{\sin 3x-\sin x}{\ln(x+1)}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{\sin 3x - \sin x}{x}}{\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}} \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{3\cdot\frac{\sin 3x}{3x} - \frac{\sin x}{x}}{\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}} \\ &= \frac{3(1) - 1}{1} = 2 \end{aligned}\)

  5. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{x-\ln (1+3x)}{x+\sin 3x}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\frac{x - \ln(1+3x)}{x}}{\frac{x + \sin 3x}{x}} \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1 - 3\cdot\frac{\ln(1+3x)}{3x}}{1 + 3\cdot\frac{\sin 3x}{3x}} \\ &= \frac{1 - 3(1)}{1 + 3(1)} = -\frac{1}{2} \end{aligned}\)

ដំណោះស្រាយ (ត)

  1. \(\lim_{ x \to 1 } \frac{x^2-1+\ln x}{e^x-e}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    តាង \(u = x-1 \Rightarrow x = u +1\)
    បើ \(x\to 1 \Rightarrow u \to 0\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{u \to 0} \frac{(1+u)^2 - 1 + \ln(1+u)}{e^{u+1} - e} \\ &= \lim_{u \to 0} \frac{2u + u^2 + \ln(1+u)}{e(e^u - 1)} \\ &= \frac{1}{e}\lim_{u \to 0} \frac{2 + u + \frac{\ln(1+u)}{u}}{\frac{e^u - 1}{u}} \\ &= \frac{1}{e}\left( \frac{2 + 0 + 1}{1} \right) = \frac{3}{e} \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{\ln (1+2x^2)}{1-\cos 2x}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1+2x^2)}{2\sin^2 x} \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1+2x^2)}{2x^2} \times \frac{x^2}{\sin^2 x}\right] \\ &= 1 \times 1 = 1 \end{aligned}\)

  3. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{\ln (\cos 2x)}{x^2}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln(1 - 2\sin^2 x)}{x^2} \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1 - 2\sin^2 x)}{-2\sin^2 x} \times \frac{-2\sin^2 x}{x^2}\right] \\ &= 1 \times (-2 \times 1) = -2 \end{aligned}\)

  4. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{\ln (x^2-x+1)}{x}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\ln[1 + x(x - 1)]}{x} \\ &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln[1 + x(x - 1)]}{x(x - 1)} \times (x - 1)\right] \\ &= 1 \times (0 - 1) = -1 \end{aligned}\)

  5. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{\ln (1+x)+\ln (1+2x)}{x}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[ \frac{\ln(1+x)}{x} + 2\cdot\frac{\ln(1+2x)}{2x} \right] \\ &= 1 + 2(1) = 3 \end{aligned}\)

  6. \(\lim_{ x \to 0 } \frac{\ln (1+2\sin^2x)}{3\tan ^2x}\) , រាងមិនកំណត់ \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x \to 0} \left[\frac{\ln(1 + 2\sin^2 x)}{2\sin^2 x} \times \frac{2\cos^2 x}{3}\right] \\ &= 1 \times \frac{2(1)}{3} = \frac{2}{3} \end{aligned}\)

ដោះស្រាយលីមីតខាងក្រោម៖

  1. \(\lim_{x\to 2}\frac{\sqrt{2+\sqrt{\cdots+\sqrt{2+x}}}-2}{x-2}\) (\(n\) ឫសការេ)
    គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់នៃភាគយក៖
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 2}\frac{(\sqrt{2+\cdots+\sqrt{2+x}})^2 - 2^2}{(x-2)(\sqrt{2+\cdots+\sqrt{2+x}}+2)} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 2}\frac{\sqrt{2+\cdots+\sqrt{2+x}}-2}{(x-2)(\sqrt{2+\cdots+\sqrt{2+x}}+2)} \end{aligned}\)
    បន្តគុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ \(n\) ដង យើងទទួលបាន៖
    \(\begin{aligned} &= \lim_{x\to 2}\frac{x-2}{(x-2)\underbrace{(\sqrt{2+\cdots}+2)\cdots(\sqrt{2+x}+2)}_{n \text{ កត្តា}}} \\ &= \frac{1}{\underbrace{4\cdot 4\cdots 4}_{n \text{ កត្តា}}} = \frac{1}{4^n} \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1-(1+x)(1+2x)\cdots(1+nx)}{x}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    តាមរូបមន្តពន្លាត យើងមាន៖
    \((1+x)(1+2x)\cdots(1+nx)\)
    \(= 1 + (1+2+\cdots+n)x + x^2 P(x)\)
    \(= 1 + \frac{n(n+1)}{2}x + x^2 P(x)\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1-\left[1+\frac{n(n+1)}{2}x+x^2 P(x)\right]}{x} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0}\left[-\frac{n(n+1)}{2} - x P(x)\right] \\ &= -\frac{n(n+1)}{2} \end{aligned}\)

ដំណោះស្រាយ (ត)

  1. \(\lim_{x\to 1}\frac{x+x^2+\cdots+x^n-n}{x+x^2+\cdots+x^m-m}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    យើងមាន \(n = \underbrace{1+1+\cdots+1}_{n \text{ តួ}}\) នាំឱ្យ៖
    \(x+x^2+\cdots+x^n-n = \sum_{k=1}^n (x^k-1)\)
    \(= (x-1)\sum_{k=1}^n (x^{k-1}+\cdots+1)\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 1}\frac{(x-1)\sum_{k=1}^n (x^{k-1}+\cdots+1)}{(x-1)\sum_{j=1}^m (x^{j-1}+\cdots+1)} \\ &= \frac{1+2+\cdots+n}{1+2+\cdots+m} \\ &= \frac{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}}{\frac{m(m+1)}{2}} = \frac{n(n+1)}{m(m+1)} \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{x\to a}\frac{x^n-a^n-na^{n-1}x+na^n}{(x-a)^2}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    ភាគយកអាចសរសេរជា៖
    \(x^n-a^n-na^{n-1}(x-a)\)
    \(= (x-a)(x^{n-1}+\cdots+a^{n-1}) - na^{n-1}(x-a)\)
    \(= (x-a)\left[(x^{n-1}-a^{n-1})+\cdots+a^{n-2}(x-a)\right]\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to a}\left[\frac{x^{n-1}-a^{n-1}}{x-a} + \cdots + a^{n-2}\right] \\ &= (n-1)a^{n-2} + \cdots + a^{n-2} \\ &= a^{n-2}[1+2+\cdots+(n-1)] \\ &= \frac{n(n-1)a^{n-2}}{2} \end{aligned}\)

  3. \(\lim_{x\to 1}\frac{x^n-nx+n-1}{x-1}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 1}\frac{(x^n-1)-n(x-1)}{x-1} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 1}\frac{(x-1)(x^{n-1}+\cdots+1)-n(x-1)}{x-1} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 1}\left[(x^{n-1}+\cdots+1)-n\right] \\ &= \underbrace{1+1+\cdots+1}_{n \text{ តួ}} - n \\ &= n - n = 0 \end{aligned}\)

  4. \(\lim_{x\to 1}\frac{nx^{n+1}-(n+1)x^n+1}{x^{m+1}-x^m-x+1}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    ភាគបែង៖
    \(x^{m+1}-x^m-x+1 = (x-1)(x^m-1)\)
    ភាគយក៖
    \(nx^n(x-1) - (x^n-1)\)
    \(= (x-1)[nx^n-(x^{n-1}+\cdots+1)]\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 1}\frac{nx^n-(x^{n-1}+\cdots+1)}{x^m-1} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 1}\frac{\frac{nx^n-(x^{n-1}+\cdots+1)}{x-1}}{\frac{x^m-1}{x-1}} \\ &= \frac{1+2+\cdots+n}{m} = \frac{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}}{m} = \frac{n(n+1)}{2m} \end{aligned}\)

ដំណោះស្រាយ (ត)

  1. \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{x^{100}+(x+1)^{100}+\cdots+(x+100)^{100}}{x^{100}+100^{100}}\)
    ដាក់ \(x^{100}\) ជាកត្តារួម៖
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{x^{100}\left[1+\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^{100}+\cdots+\left(1+\frac{100}{x}\right)^{100}\right]}{x^{100}\left[1+\left(\frac{100}{x}\right)^{100}\right]} \\ &= \frac{1+\overbrace{1+1+\cdots+1}^{100 \text{ តួ}}}{1+0} \\ &= 1 + 100 = 101 \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{n\to +\infty}\left(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}+\cdots+\frac{1}{2^n}\right)\)
    ជាផលបូកស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រ \(a=\frac{1}{2}, q=\frac{1}{2}\)៖
    \(S_n = \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1-\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n}{1-\frac{1}{2}} = 1 - \frac{1}{2^n}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\left(1-\frac{1}{2^n}\right) \\ &= 1 - 0 = 1 \end{aligned}\)

  3. \(\lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{1}{\sqrt{2k+1}+\sqrt{2k-1}}\)
    គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់តួទី \(k\)៖
    \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2k+1}+\sqrt{2k-1}} = \frac{\sqrt{2k+1}-\sqrt{2k-1}}{2}\)
    ផលបូកកាត់បន្តបន្ទាប់គ្នា៖
    \(\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{\sqrt{2k+1}-\sqrt{2k-1}}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{2n+1}-1}{2}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{\sqrt{2n+1}-1}{2\sqrt{n}} \\ &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{\sqrt{2+\frac{1}{n}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \end{aligned}\)

  4. \(\lim_{n\to +\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n\frac{1}{(3k-2)(3k+1)(3k+4)}\)
    បំបែកជាផលដកពីរប្រភាគ៖
    \(\frac{1}{(3k-2)(3k+1)(3k+4)}\)
    \(= \frac{1}{6}\left[\frac{1}{(3k-2)(3k+1)}-\frac{1}{(3k+1)(3k+4)}\right]\)
    ផលបូកកាត់បន្តបន្ទាប់គ្នា៖
    \(S_n = \frac{1}{6}\left[\frac{1}{1\cdot 4} - \frac{1}{(3n+1)(3n+4)}\right]\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{1}{6}\left[\frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{(3n+1)(3n+4)}\right] \\ &= \frac{1}{6}\left(\frac{1}{4}-0\right) = \frac{1}{24} \end{aligned}\)

  5. \(\lim_{n\to +\infty}\prod_{k=0}^n\left(1+x^{2^k}\right)\) , \(|x|<1\)
    គុណនិងចែកនឹង \(1-x\)៖
    \(P_n = \frac{(1-x)(1+x)(1+x^2)\cdots(1+x^{2^n})}{1-x}\)
    \(= \frac{1-x^{2^{n+1}}}{1-x}\)
    ដោយ \(|x|<1 \Rightarrow \lim_{n\to +\infty}x^{2^{n+1}} = 0\)៖
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{1-x^{2^{n+1}}}{1-x} \\ &= \frac{1-0}{1-x} = \frac{1}{1-x} \end{aligned}\)

ដំណោះស្រាយ (ត)

  1. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{e^x+e^{2x}+\cdots+e^{nx}-n}{x}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    បំបែក \(n = \underbrace{1+1+\cdots+1}_{n \text{ តួ}}\)៖
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 0}\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{e^{kx}-1}{x} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0}\sum_{k=1}^n k\cdot\frac{e^{kx}-1}{kx} \\ &= \sum_{k=1}^n k\cdot 1 = 1+2+\cdots+n \\ &= \frac{n(n+1)}{2} \end{aligned}\)

  2. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{(e^x-1)(e^{2x}-1)\cdots(e^{nx}-1)}{x^n}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{0}{0}\)
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 0}\prod_{k=1}^n \frac{e^{kx}-1}{x} \\ &= \lim_{x\to 0}\prod_{k=1}^n\left(k\cdot\frac{e^{kx}-1}{kx}\right) \\ &= \prod_{k=1}^n (k\cdot 1) = 1\cdot 2\cdots n = n! \end{aligned}\)

  3. \(\lim_{x\to 1}\left(\frac{n}{1-x^n}-\frac{1}{1-x}\right)\) , រាង \(\infty-\infty\)
    តម្រូវភាគបែងរួម៖
    \(\frac{n-(1+x+\cdots+x^{n-1})}{1-x^n}\)
    \(= \frac{(1-x)+(1-x^2)+\cdots+(1-x^{n-1})}{1-x^n}\)
    សម្រួលនឹង \(1-x\)៖
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{x\to 1}\frac{1+(1+x)+\cdots+(1+x+\cdots+x^{n-2})}{1+x+\cdots+x^{n-1}} \\ &= \frac{1+2+\cdots+(n-1)}{n} \\ &= \frac{\frac{n(n-1)}{2}}{n} = \frac{n-1}{2} \end{aligned}\)

  4. \(\lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{n^2-1}{1+2+3+\cdots+n}\) , រាង \(\tfrac{\infty}{\infty}\)
    យើងមាន \(1+2+3+\cdots+n = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}\)៖
    \(\begin{aligned} \text{យើងបាន } &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{2(n^2-1)}{n(n+1)} \\ &= \lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{2n^2\left(1-\frac{1}{n^2}\right)}{n^2\left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)} \\ &= \frac{2(1-0)}{1+0} = 2 \end{aligned}\)

លំហាត់

សិក្សាភាពជាប់ ឬរកប៉ារ៉ាម៉ែត្រ ដើម្បីឱ្យអនុគមន៍ខាងក្រោមជាប់ត្រង់ចំណុចដែលគេឲ្យ៖

  1. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\dfrac{x^2-x-2}{x-2} & \text{បើ } x\ne 2\\ 3 & \text{បើ } x=2\end{cases}\) ត្រង់ \(x=2\)

  2. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\dfrac{|x|}{x} & \text{បើ } x\ne 0\\ 1 & \text{បើ } x=0\end{cases}\) ត្រង់ \(x=0\)

  3. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\dfrac{x^3-8}{x-2} & \text{បើ } x\ne 2\\ k & \text{បើ } x=2\end{cases}\) ; រក \(k\)

  4. \(f(x)=\begin{cases}ax+1 & \text{បើ } x\le 2\\ x^2-1 & \text{បើ } x>2\end{cases}\) ; រក \(a\)

  1. គេមាន \(f(2)=3\) ។
    \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2}\dfrac{x^2-x-2}{x-2}=\lim\limits_{x\to 2}\dfrac{(x-2)(x+1)}{x-2}=\lim\limits_{x\to 2}(x+1)=3\) ។
    ដោយ \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2}f(x)=f(2)=3\)
    ដូចនេះ \(f\) ជាប់ត្រង់ \(x=2\)

  2. គេមាន \(f(0)=1\) ។
    \(\lim\limits_{x\to 0^+}\dfrac{|x|}{x}=\lim\limits_{x\to 0^+}\dfrac{x}{x}=1\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to 0^-}\dfrac{|x|}{x}=\lim\limits_{x\to 0^-}\dfrac{-x}{x}=-1\) ។
    ដោយលីមីតឆ្វេងខុសពីលីមីតស្ដាំ \(\lim\limits_{x\to 0}f(x)\) គ្មាន ។
    ដូចនេះ \(f\) ដាច់ត្រង់ \(x=0\) (តែ \(f\) ជាប់ខាងស្ដាំត្រង់ \(0\))

  3. \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2}\dfrac{x^3-8}{x-2}=\lim\limits_{x\to 2}\dfrac{(x-2)(x^2+2x+4)}{x-2}=\lim\limits_{x\to 2}(x^2+2x+4)=12\) ។
    \(f\) ជាប់ត្រង់ \(2\) លុះត្រាតែ \(f(2)=\lim\limits_{x\to 2}f(x)\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

  4. \(f(2)=2a+1\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^-}f(x)=\lim\limits_{x\to 2^-}(ax+1)=2a+1\) ។
    \(\lim\limits_{x\to 2^+}f(x)=\lim\limits_{x\to 2^+}(x^2-1)=3\) ។
    \(f\) ជាប់ត្រង់ \(2\) លុះត្រាតែ \(2a+1=3\) ។
    ដូចនេះ

លំហាត់

  1. បង្ហាញថាសមីការ \(x^5+x-1=0\) មានឫសតែមួយគត់ក្នុងចន្លោះ \(]0, 1[\) ។

  2. បង្ហាញថាសមីការ \(\ln x+x=0\) មានឫសតែមួយគត់ក្នុងចន្លោះ \(\left]\dfrac{1}{e}, 1\right[\) ។

  3. រកអាស៊ីមតូតនៃខ្សែកោងតាងអនុគមន៍ \(f(x)=\dfrac{x^2+x+1}{x+1}\) ។

  4. រកអាស៊ីមតូតនៃខ្សែកោងតាងអនុគមន៍ \(g(x)=\dfrac{3x-1}{x+2}\) ។

  1. តាង \(f(x)=x^5+x-1\) ជាអនុគមន៍ពហុធា ដូចនេះជាប់លើ \([0, 1]\) ។
    \(f(0)=-1<0\) និង \(f(1)=1>0\) នាំឱ្យ \(f(0)\cdot f(1)<0\) ។
    \(f'(x)=5x^4+1>0\) នាំឱ្យ \(f\) កើនដាច់ខាត ។
    ដូចនេះ សមីការមានឫសតែមួយគត់ក្នុង \(]0, 1[\)

  2. តាង \(f(x)=\ln x+x\) ជាប់លើ \(]0,+\infty[\) ដូចនេះជាប់លើ \(\left[\frac{1}{e},1\right]\) ។
    \(f\left(\frac{1}{e}\right)=-1+\frac{1}{e}<0\) (ព្រោះ \(\frac{1}{e}<1\)) និង \(f(1)=0+1=1>0\) ។
    \(f'(x)=\frac{1}{x}+1>0\) នាំឱ្យ \(f\) កើនដាច់ខាត ។
    ដូចនេះ សមីការមានឫសតែមួយគត់ក្នុង \(\left]\frac{1}{e}, 1\right[\)

  3. ដែនកំណត់ \(D=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-1\}\) ។ ចែកពហុធាបាន \(f(x)=x+\dfrac{1}{x+1}\) ។
    \(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to -1^+}f(x)=+\infty\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to -1^-}f(x)=-\infty\) នាំឱ្យ \(x=-1\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតឈរ ។
    \(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to\pm\infty}\left[f(x)-x\right]=\lim\limits_{x\to\pm\infty}\dfrac{1}{x+1}=0\) នាំឱ្យ \(y=x\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតទ្រេត ។
    ដូចនេះ \(x=-1\) និង \(y=x\)

  4. ដែនកំណត់ \(D=\mathbb{R}\setminus\{-2\}\) ។ គេសរសេរ \(g(x)=3-\dfrac{7}{x+2}\) ។
    \(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to\pm\infty}g(x)=3\) នាំឱ្យ \(y=3\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតដេក ។
    \(\bullet\) \(\lim\limits_{x\to -2^+}g(x)=-\infty\) និង \(\lim\limits_{x\to -2^-}g(x)=+\infty\) នាំឱ្យ \(x=-2\) ជាអាស៊ីមតូតឈរ ។
    ដូចនេះ \(x=-2\) និង \(y=3\)
